asr.full_text: hello everyone and thank you for tuning into the financial investor channel my name is Brent and today we're going to be talking about Robinhood what happens when you transfer from Robinhood to another broker well as it happens I made that choice to transfer last Friday from Robinhood over to merrill edge so I submitted my paperwork which I made a video on you saw what took place what you had to have you had to have an end-of-month statement from Robin Hood and the transfer paperwork filled out check that out in my other video here short than in the other video I showed all that information off after that takes place it's supposed to take between 2 to 5 business days today is Tuesday when I logged on to Robin Hood I had this new notification that my Robin Hood account has been closed if you have any questions please contact support so if you are making a full transfer from one broker to another Robin Hood does close out your account so say if you wanted to continue using another broker along another Robin Hood does close out your account so say if you wanted to continue using another broker along with Robin Hood Robin Hood will close at your account during the process looks like you can contact support and if you do click on contact support you have different categories Robin Hood gold Robin Hood and since stocks trading banking my account report a bug future or feature request so in my case I would save my account and then I would choose reactivate my account and if we click on this I'm sure it would give a description you would type it in and then you could attach anything you would want and you can send it off to Robin Hood in this case I'm not going to be worrying too much about it now that notification just went away so some things that you cannot do once your account is closed is you cannot make another trade so for instance here I have a hundred and one dollars currently sitting as buying power in my portfolio I cannot go over to Abby and make a purchase if I were to select buy and put in one share and hit OK and swipe up I would say air account has been deactivated contact support at Robin hood calm so they closed out my account I can no longer make any more buys or sells so that is actually important because they're going to be transferring all of my stocks over to merrill edge so they need to know that any new socks are not going to be purchased from this account and then have some sort of issues in the future whether or not open tomorrow edge and create some sort of frustration either on my end or on there and so they do this as a precautionary sort of thing so I totally get that that's fine so that is there for this video so if your account gets if you transfer brokers from one broker to another they deactivate your account that means that you can no longer buy or sell stocks from your Robinhood portfolio you can still see how the movement has been for the week you can still go in here and see your history your dividends your pending stuff your deposits and everything else that you have done prior to your transfer gist from that point on with your account is closed out now you can not make any new purchases or sales so that is it for this video I want to thank you for watching up until this point and of course if you did like the video hit the like button below if it did help you go ahead and leave them in the comments below that it helped you out and please remember to subscribe for future financial videos if you have any questions about Robin Hood or the closing process go ahead and leave them in the comments below and let know I will always reply back you guys comment thanks for tuning in and I will see you next time bye
